PROFESSIONAL ($350/year)  

Take your support to the next level with Professional Membership. Receive premium perks, including 20% off workshops, a complimentary tintype session, and more.

Discounts

  • 20% Discount on all Workshops and Online Classes

  • 20% Discount on Film Processing at LTI Lightside

  • 15% Discount  on Highlight Studio rentals

  • 20% Discount on Tintype Studio Portrait Sessions

  • One-Time Free 8x10 Tintype Session OR Gift Card

Facilities

  • Access to our Library Collection of early photography books and manuals

  • Access to rent our:

    • Inkjet Printers

    • B&W Darkroom

    • Alt Process Darkroom

    • Risograph Machine

    • Flatbed Scanner

    • Imacon

    • GFX Digitization Station

Opportunities & Events

  • Eligibility to submit your work to our Members Online Gallery

  • Invitation to Member Events (Artist studio visits, gallery tours, Open Studios for Student & Educator Members)

Partner Benefits

  • Exclusive benefits at our partner organizations:

    • Printed Matter

    • Filter Photo

    • Society for Photographic Education

    • Women Photographers International Archive

Your membership is a non-refundable, tax-deductible contribution that keeps our community thriving, sustains our education and public programs, and supports our operational costs. With your gift, we can continue offering an array of resources and activities including year-round education, artists' lectures, and photography exhibitions.

*The Penumbra Foundation is a tax-exempt charitable organization under Section 501(c)(3) of the Internal Revenue Code. Your membership and/or donations are tax-deductible to the extent allowed by law. Please contact your tax advisor for further information.
